thread:
Maya Patel: quick sync — we need a crisp GA checklist for Predict API (SLA, docs, support routing, monitoring, pricing). can owners confirm what’s blocking?
Samir Khan: SLA numbers: proposed 99.9% p99 latency 200ms for text-gen, 50ms for embeddings. need legal on SLO penalties.
Karla Liu: support routing: Tier1 must handle auth/billing + basic errors; Tier2 engs for model regressions. Who owns the runbook? @Owen?
Owen Reyes: I can own runbook. need runbook template + three playbooks: latency spike, model-quality regression, quota exhaustion.
Maya Patel: cool. runbook template: see https://redwood.internal/runbooks/template (draft). Owen, can you fill latency spike and quota playbooks by Thu?
Owen Reyes: yes — will draft. also raising capacity question: traffic pattern during GA could double baseline. do we have burst autoscale guardrails?
Samir Khan: autoscale policy exists for Dedicated. For Hosted, we have burst pool but need explicit budget/quotas per customer. product -> finops to lock pricing/quotas.
Karla Liu: support staffing: we need an oncall rotation for first two weeks post-GA. recommend ops + eng hybrid. Samir, can you propose rota?
Samir Khan: will propose rota and updated escalation matrix today.
Maya Patel: docs: API reference + quickstart + migration notes. Docs PR is in flight: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2345 — reviewers: @Karla, @Samir.
Karla Liu: reviewing now. will add support runbook link and contact SSE for Tier2.
Owen Reyes: monitoring: dashboards for latency, error-rate, token-cost delta, KV cache hit-rate. also add prompt-regression alerts tied to eval set.
Maya Patel: great — add alert thresholds to the GA checklist. we need owners for each: SLA (Samir), Docs (Karla), Support (Karla), Monitoring (Owen), Pricing (Maya + FinOps).
Samir Khan: noted. still pending: legal signoff on SLOs and commercial for pricing bands. chasing both.
deploy-bot: integration-tests/ga-readiness passed — 12 checks — coverage 98%.
Maya Patel: blockers list (quick):
- Legal SLO approval (owner: Samir)
- Pricing bands + quota model (owner: Maya/FinOps)
- Support rota + runbooks (owner: Karla/Owen)
- Monitoring + alerts wired (owner: Owen)
- Docs PR merge (owner: Karla)
- Performance spike smoke test (owner: Eng-Perf)
Karla Liu: can we get a short public-facing blurb for sales and AE? we need a one-pager on SLAs + pricing tiers.
Maya Patel: yes — marketing + sales ops will draft. I'll loop them in after we lock numbers.
Samir Khan: target: freeze SLA and pricing by Fri COB. if we miss, we delay GA by one week.
Owen Reyes: I'll prioritize load tests today and post results in thread.
Maya Patel: thanks. final ask: everyone add a one-line readiness status to the checklist doc before EOD. I'll compile and send for greenlight. :thumbsup:
Samir Khan: done
Karla Liu: done
Owen Reyes: will update after tests
deploy-bot: scheduled smoke test at 6234569000
Maya Patel: closing — thanks team.
